description: Poll a job until it reaches FINISHED, FAILED or CANCELED, or until the wait budget runs out. Defaults: poll every 5s, wait up to 30s; a timed-out result is not an error — call again to keep waiting.

maxWaitSeconds.description: Wall-clock budget in seconds (default 30). Above ~50 needs an MCP client configured with a longer request timeout.

name: transkribus_job_wait
title: Wait for Job
